name: terraflow
description: TerraFlow - Configurable Real Estate Import Engine (monorepo)

scripts.build:web: npm -w @terraflow/web run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join('apps','web','dist'),dst=path.join('apps','api','public');fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Web build copied to apps/api/public (served on :3000)');"
